brief:
Gaza Civil Defense teams recovered 233 bodies, including 73 children, over 51 days of operations, Middle East Eye reported. The recoveries occurred as part of what the Civil Defense called its "second phase of recovery operations," according to a statement by the organization.

The Civil Defense has continued search and rescue operations months after major conflict events in Gaza. The organization did not specify the timeframe for when these deaths occurred or provide additional context on the circumstances of the recoveries.
